remarks: Endless Potential in Prime Location! Bring your vision and transform this Westport gem into the home of your dreams! In the sought-after Greens Farms neighborhood, this property offers a rare opportunity to renovate and customize to your taste. The main residence is brimming with potential, while a beautifully finished attached legal rental unit provides immediate income or flexible living space. Enjoy an unbeatable lifestyle just a quick bike ride or walk to the beach, train station, and everything Westport has to offer-from top-rated schools and vibrant dining to shopping, arts, and community amenities. Don't miss your chance to create something truly special in one of Westport's most desirable locations!
